title: Party Step Added for the Drivers the Higher Cover Reaches, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
A party step is added to the difference due on a move of level for the drivers the higher cover is extended
to, counted from the fees for additional drivers standing on the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election.

1. Where the election's charge lines carry a fee for 2 additional drivers or more, a step of 60.00 USD is
   added.
2. Where they carry a fee for exactly 1 additional driver, a step of 30.00 USD is added.
3. Where they carry no fee for an additional driver, a step of 0.00 USD is added.

## The three cases as a table

| Fees for additional drivers standing on the election | Party step added |
|---|---|
| 3 | 60.00 USD |
| 2 | 60.00 USD |
| 1 | 30.00 USD |
| 0 | 0.00 USD |

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election carrying two lines each charging an additional driver fee takes a step of 60.00 USD, and so does
one carrying four such lines, the step being flat once the second driver is reached. An election carrying a
single such line takes 30.00 USD. An election on which no additional driver has been charged takes nothing on
this account, whatever the level moved to.
